rules.Top5_LowVol26w: Take the top 5 predicted stocks that have a complete 26-week volatility history and weight them by inverse volatility, capped at 35% per stock; with fewer than 5 stocks the equity budget is count/5 and the rest stays in cash.
rules.Top5_RankRisk26w: From the same eligible pool take the top 5 and weight by (6 - rank) / 26-week standard deviation of weekly returns, capped at 35% per stock; with fewer than 5 stocks the equity budget is count/5.
rules.Top5_Buffer10: Start with the top 5; each week keep holdings that are still in the current top 10, fill empty slots by current rank, then rebalance to equal weights of 20% each.
rules.Top5_Rebalance2w: Buy the top 5 from cash on the first available signal and re-select equal weights every 2 calendar weeks; in between, holdings and cash drift naturally and no trades follow new ranks. A missing signal liquidates; a returning signal buys immediately and resets the rebalance clock.
rules.Top5_Rebalance4w: Same as above, rebalancing every 4 calendar weeks.
rules.Top5_Trend26w: Build an equal-weight return index from verifiable adjusted prices of the original universe up to the current week; buy the equal-weight Top5 when the index is above its 26-week moving average (including the current week), otherwise hold cash.
rules.Consensus: Equal-weight average of the weekly within-universe rank percentiles of the four model families for the same factor set; scores are rounded to 12 decimals to fix numerical ties, then ties break by ticker; only stocks and dates predicted by all four are used.

consensus: same-factor four-family percentile average; missing family means no consensus
positive_score: literal prediction > 0; Ranker scores do not imply positive expected return
